key.name: panel-sensors
key.description: The temperatures in the panel, one or two, by reading ID (the chip and the feature, as "coretemp-isa-0000/temp1"), as the popup's pins set them. Empty for the defaults: the CPU's, and the hottest GPU reading when there's a GPU. While a pin's chip is gone, the defaults are shown until it comes back.

key.name: units
key.description: The temperatures in °C or °F, in the panel, the tooltip and the popup.

key.name: warm-threshold
key.description: The temperature in °C from which a reading is warm, and orange.

key.name: hot-threshold
key.description: The temperature in °C from which a reading is hot, and red; from its crit minus 5 when that's lower.

key.name: show-all
key.description: Whether the popup's "Show all sensors" is open.
